name: 有田哲平とコスられない街
original_name: 有田哲平とコスられない街
overview:
‘Tetsuhei Arita and the Town Where You Won’t Be Cosplayed’ (Arita Tetsuhei to Kosararenai Machi) is a variety programme produced by TBS Television. Its abbreviated title is ‘Ari-Kos’.

It is a hyper-local neighbourhood exploration variety programme in which Tetsuhei Arita takes an in-depth stroll through the streets based on ‘information that hasn’t been covered by the media (or has received little coverage)’.
